description: Known issues found by scripts/check-integrity.js after normalization: per rule and Category key (event/year/category), the exact count still waiting for a fix from the source. header_warnings: normalizer warnings, e.g. race-info.json maps a column the TSV lacks, or the TSV is missing. missing_laps: lap times missing for finished athletes in segments that map a lap column. missing_total: finished athletes with no total time. A new Import must add nothing. Record a gap only when the source itself lacks the data, and say so in the commit message. Counts otherwise only shrink (docs/adr/0002-known-issue-counts-only-shrink.md). Update with `bun run update:integrity-baseline`.
